title: 第1978章 栽赃陷害质疑天机第1977章 守护界河接替神位
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
陈青玄没有回答，他抓住陈青机就要离开。
诡之道主当然不可能让他如愿。
于是，在他的操纵下，那股抽象的画风快速朝着二人汇聚。
所到之处，一切都像是被同化了一样。
这便是属于“诡之道宫”的能力。
可是下一秒。
就有一道剑光径直斩出，将诡之道主的攻势斩灭。
见此情形，诡之道主并没有任何诧异的意思，此举可谓正中下怀！
他的目的从一开始就不是要将陈青玄困住。
作为天机师，大部分情况下他们不需要知道答案，只需要相关的线索就足够了。
诡之道主截取了陈青玄释放出的那股剑气，很快开始推演剑气的来源。
这股合体境的力量，本身应当归属于特定的神位。
他只要通过神位确定了对方的身份，那么无论玄机兄弟逃到天涯海角，他也能直接锁定二人的位置。
于是，这道剑气对应的神位很快有了结果。
【剑魄凌霄】
诡之道主愣了下。
他要是没有记错的话，这道神位当前就归属于诡之大道属下的一位神君。
此人的神位并不属于诡之大道，而是隶属剑之大道。
但他选择加入“诡之大道”的阵营。
这一刻，诡之道主的脑海中闪过了无数的念头。

他的第一个想法是背叛！
此人竟敢背叛自己，罪不可赦！
诡之道主直接催动了大道信物。
下一秒，他的脚下就生出了无数的阴影，那些阴影落在地上的部分仿佛藤条，快速抓住了其中一道人影。
这人影正是【剑魄凌霄】这道神位的主人。
他本来待在诡之大道的营地里。
突然，诡之道主的力量笼罩他全身，将他带到了诡之道主的身前。
【剑魄凌霄】本以为诡之道主是准备给他开小灶了，所以整个人还有些兴奋。
不料——
诡之道主直接将他的力量全部压制。
紧接着，在【剑魄凌霄】错愕的目光中，他的耳边传来了诡之道主冰冷的声音。
“这就是背叛者的下场。”
他的意识逐渐变得模糊，视野范围也天旋地转。
直到神道被摧毁的那一刻。
【剑魄凌霄】的脑海中仍在回荡“背叛者”三个字。
content_en:
Chen Qingxuan didn't answer, he grabbed Chen Qingji and was about to leave.
Of course, it is impossible for the Master of Wei to make him wish.
So, under his control, the abstract painting style quickly gathered towards the two of them.
Everywhere you go, everything seems to be assimilated.
This is the ability that belongs to the "Palace of Weird Way".
But the next second.
There was a sword light that cut straight out, killing the offensive of the Taoist Master.
Seeing this situation, the Taoist Master Wei was not surprised at all. This move was exactly what he wanted!
His purpose from the beginning was not to trap Chen Qingxuan.
As secret masters, in most cases they don't need to know the answer, only relevant clues are enough.
The Taoist Master intercepted the sword energy released by Chen Qingxuan and quickly began to deduce the source of the sword energy.
This power of unity should belong to a specific god.
As long as he determines the identity of the other party through the divine position, no matter whether the Xuanji brothers escape to the end of the world, he can directly lock the two brothers' positions.
As a result, the divine position corresponding to this sword energy soon came to fruition.
【Sword Soul Lingxiao】
The Taoist Master was stunned for a moment.
If he remembers correctly, this divine position currently belongs to a divine king under Wei Zhidao.
This person's divine position does not belong to the Dao of Gui, but to the Dao of Sword.
But he chose to join the camp of "The Avenue of Strangeness".
At this moment, countless thoughts flashed through Master Wei's mind.
His first thought was betrayal!
This person dared to betray himself. His crime is unpardonable!
The Tao Master of Wei directly activated the Tao Token.
The next second, countless shadows appeared under his feet, and the parts of those shadows that fell on the ground were like vines, quickly catching one of the figures.
This figure is the owner of the divine position [Sword Soul Lingxiao].
He was originally staying in the camp on Weird Avenue.
Suddenly, the power of the Taoist Master enveloped his whole body and brought him to the Taoist Master.
[Sword Soul Lingxiao] I thought that the Taoist Master of Wei was going to give him a small start, so he was a little excited.
Unexpectedly——
The Taoist Master directly suppressed all his power.
Then, under the stunned gaze of [Sword Soul Lingxiao], the cold voice of the Taoist Master of Wei came to his ears.
"This is what happens to betrayers."
His consciousness gradually became blurred, and his field of vision was spinning.
Until the moment Shinto was destroyed.
The word "betrayer" is still echoing in [Sword Soul Lingxiao]'s mind.
